label: default agent • Osaurus-flavoured vocabulary in a general question does not trigger osaurus_help
query: In general terms — not about Osaurus specifically — what is a language model's context window, and why does a bigger one cost more memory? Keep it to three sentences.
notes: Help-routing honesty: `osaurus_help` answers questions about Osaurus itself (features, settings, where a control lives). A general machine-learning question that merely uses words the guide also uses (context window, memory, model) must be answered from the Orchestrator's own knowledge — no `osaurus_help`, no `osaurus_inspect`, no `osaurus_config`, no delegation, no web tools. Complements quick-question-no-spawn (which uses vocabulary with no Osaurus overlap). Tool-free expectation keeps this runnable on tiny-window models.

rubric: Explains the context window as the amount of text/tokens the model can attend to at once, and ties larger windows to more memory (for example the KV cache / attention state growing with sequence length).
Does NOT describe Osaurus settings, guide pages, or offer to open Settings — it answers the general question.
Stays brief — about three sentences, no option menus or follow-up questions.
